messages:
elaine: Quick sync 1: hit a dup-create issue in the onboarding sampleapp under burst 429s. Node SDK retried too eagerly and we got duplicate users.

raj: Oof. Is this the equal-jitter default causing synchronized retries?

elaine: Yup. Equal jitter + fast token refresh race. The sampleapp doesn't set Idempotency-Key headers so backend treated retries as fresh creates.

sam: FYI Python SDK used to set a lightweight Idempotency-Key for POST create endpoints. Node README doesn't call that out.

linda: Proposal: sampleapp auto-generates Idempotency-Key per outbound POST and server keeps a short-lived dedupe table (TTL 90s).

elaine: Also propose SDK change: classify retries so POSTs are only auto-retried when an Idempotency-Key exists OR developer opts into safeReplay: true. Plus switch 429 handling to full jitter.

raj: That makes sense. Suggest a retry classifier shape: 

```js
function shouldAutoRetry(req, err) {
  if (is429(err) || isTransient(err)) {
    if (req.headers['Idempotency-Key']) return true;
    if (req.options && req.options.safeReplay) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
```

sam: Add to that: explicit opt-in flag in SDK config (global and per-request) so libs can't accidentally replay non-idempotent ops. Default remains conservative.

linda: Test plan: e2e with 300 parallel onboarding requests, inject 429 on first attempt for 30% of requests, assert zero duplicate DB rows. Add unit for token refresh happening between attempt/resend.

elaine: I'll open a PR with three pieces: (1) sampleapp header gen + server dedupe, (2) Node SDK retry classifier + default to full jitter for 429, (3) docs/quickstart update. PR title: "sdk(node): safer retry classifier + sampleapp idempotency".

raj: Can we add a short note in docs about streaming endpoints NOT being auto-replayable and recommending resume tokens for streams?

sam: Yes. Streaming = no automatic replay. Document sample pattern: resume_token + idempotency for chunked sidecars.

linda: CI on the PR? @ci-bot can you run e2e + flaky detector when PR is created? :pray:

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued for PR #4392  unit, integration, e2e.

elaine: Thanks all. After green CI we'll bump sampleapp patch and add changelog entry. Small change but high DX impact.

sam: Great catch, elaine. Happy to help review the SDK bits.

elaine: Cheers. Lesson: defaults should be conservative; opt-in for more aggressive replay behavior.
